fields.name: framework
fields.label: Framework
fields.help: The HLT-formatted scaffold whose CDR loops and dock are designed. The two bundled frameworks are the ones used in the RFantibody preprint; pick the one that matches the task. "Custom" converts the Chothia-numbered antibody PDB below into HLT format instead.

fields.name: target_file
fields.label: Target antigen PDB
fields.default: HEADER    PASTE A TARGET ANTIGEN PDB HERE
fields.help: The antigen structure. Crop it to the region around the epitope: RFdiffusion and RF2 both scale as O(N^2) in residue count.

fields.name: antigen_chains
fields.label: Antigen chains
fields.help: Comma-separated chain IDs to keep from the target PDB, for example A or A,B. Everything else in the file is dropped before the run.

fields.name: antibody_file
fields.label: Antibody PDB
fields.help: Read only when the framework is "Custom": a Chothia-numbered antibody structure, such as one downloaded from SAbDab. It is converted to HLT format using the chain IDs below.

fields.name: heavy_chain
fields.label: Heavy chain
fields.help: Chain ID of the heavy chain in the antibody PDB.

fields.name: light_chain
fields.label: Light chain
fields.help: Chain ID of the light chain in the antibody PDB.

fields.name: hotspots
fields.label: Epitope hotspots
fields.help: Comma-separated target residues that define the epitope, written as a chain ID then a residue number: A305,A456. These use the target PDB's own chain IDs and numbering. RFantibody is sensitive to the choice; pilot a few designs first.

fields.name: regions
fields.label: CDR loops to design
fields.help: Comma-separated loops: hcdr1, hcdr2, hcdr3, and in the Antibody task lcdr1, lcdr2, lcdr3. A loop left out keeps the framework's own sequence and structure through both the diffusion and the sequence-design stages.

fields.name: hcdr1_length
fields.label: HCDR1 length
fields.help: "auto" lets the model keep the framework loop's own length, or give a fixed length (7) or a range sampled per design (5-13).

fields.name: hcdr2_length
fields.label: HCDR2 length
fields.help: "auto" lets the model keep the framework loop's own length, or give a fixed length (7) or a range sampled per design (5-13).

fields.name: hcdr3_length
fields.label: HCDR3 length
fields.help: "auto" lets the model keep the framework loop's own length, or give a fixed length (7) or a range sampled per design (5-13).

fields.name: lcdr1_length
fields.label: LCDR1 length
fields.help: "auto" lets the model keep the framework loop's own length, or give a fixed length (7) or a range sampled per design (5-13).

fields.name: lcdr2_length
fields.label: LCDR2 length
fields.help: "auto" lets the model keep the framework loop's own length, or give a fixed length (7) or a range sampled per design (5-13).

fields.name: lcdr3_length
fields.label: LCDR3 length
fields.help: "auto" lets the model keep the framework loop's own length, or give a fixed length (7) or a range sampled per design (5-13).

fields.name: select_cdr_indices
fields.label: Select CDR indices
fields.help: Replace the framework's own CDR annotations with the residue indices below, rather than trusting the Chothia ranges it was labelled with.

fields.name: hcdr1_residues
fields.label: HCDR1 residues
fields.help: 1-indexed absolute residue numbers in the HLT framework (heavy chain first, then light), as 26-32 or 26,27,28. Used only when "Select CDR indices" is on; an empty box leaves that loop's existing annotation alone.

fields.name: hcdr2_residues
fields.label: HCDR2 residues
fields.help: 1-indexed absolute residue numbers in the HLT framework (heavy chain first, then light), as 26-32 or 26,27,28. Used only when "Select CDR indices" is on; an empty box leaves that loop's existing annotation alone.

fields.name: hcdr3_residues
fields.label: HCDR3 residues
fields.help: 1-indexed absolute residue numbers in the HLT framework (heavy chain first, then light), as 26-32 or 26,27,28. Used only when "Select CDR indices" is on; an empty box leaves that loop's existing annotation alone.

fields.name: lcdr1_residues
fields.label: LCDR1 residues
fields.help: 1-indexed absolute residue numbers in the HLT framework (heavy chain first, then light), as 26-32 or 26,27,28. Used only when "Select CDR indices" is on; an empty box leaves that loop's existing annotation alone.

fields.name: lcdr2_residues
fields.label: LCDR2 residues
fields.help: 1-indexed absolute residue numbers in the HLT framework (heavy chain first, then light), as 26-32 or 26,27,28. Used only when "Select CDR indices" is on; an empty box leaves that loop's existing annotation alone.

fields.name: lcdr3_residues
fields.label: LCDR3 residues
fields.help: 1-indexed absolute residue numbers in the HLT framework (heavy chain first, then light), as 26-32 or 26,27,28. Used only when "Select CDR indices" is on; an empty box leaves that loop's existing annotation alone.

fields.name: abmpnn_weights
fields.label: Use AbMPNN weights
fields.help: Run the sequence-design stage against antibody-specific AbMPNN weights instead of the ProteinMPNN checkpoint RFantibody ships. Requires ABMPNN_MODEL_PATH to be configured on the host.

fields.name: calculate_epitope_distance
fields.label: Report epitope distance
fields.help: Include RFdiffusion's per-design C-beta distance from each hotspot to the nearest designed CDR residue, as the closest and the mean over hotspots. Needs hotspots to be set.

fields.name: num_designs
fields.label: Backbone designs
fields.help: How many docked backbones the diffusion stage generates.

fields.name: temperature
fields.label: Sampling temperature
fields.help: ProteinMPNN sampling temperature; higher is more diverse and less confident.

fields.name: seqs_per_struct
fields.label: Sequences per backbone
fields.help: How many CDR sequences ProteinMPNN designs onto each backbone.

fields.name: omit_AAs
fields.label: Omitted amino acids
fields.help: One-letter codes ProteinMPNN may not place. X is always omitted; C is omitted by default to avoid unpaired cysteines.

fields.name: augment_eps
fields.label: Backbone noise
fields.help: Gaussian noise added to backbone coordinates before sequence design.

fields.name: num_connections
fields.label: Neighbours per residue
fields.help: Size of ProteinMPNN's k-nearest-neighbour graph.

fields.name: n_recycles
fields.label: RF2 recycles
fields.help: Recycling iterations in the RF2 filtering stage. RFantibody's own examples use 10; fewer is faster and less confident.

fields.name: hotspot_percentage
fields.label: Hotspots shown to RF2
fields.help: Proportion of the hotspot residues revealed to RF2 when it predicts the designed complex. Showing all of them makes the prediction less independent of the design.

fields.name: save_trajectories
fields.label: Keep diffusion trajectories
fields.help: Write RFdiffusion's per-step trajectory PDBs alongside the designs.
